evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'just need about ten to fifteen minutes, if that's okay... create a profile for you... A power personal estimate' — time-boxed ask present, but no explicit statement of the 'dependable quote' promise, and no clear wait for affirmative before continuing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing (move date, zip code, property type) with no 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' query.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), bedrooms (2), square footage (~1200), floor level (ground), walking distance (20-30 ft), additional rooms (none beyond bedrooms), special considerations (oversized items—none; furniture being sold/delivered new). Destination property type (house), stories (2-story), room distribution for items all covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'typically we might be, we might end up packing $25 to 35 boxes. Do you think you would just for it in that range in total?' Customer confirms likely less than 25–35, rep adjusts to lower range of 25.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. No recognizable version of 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor and personalization: '$109 per hour per mover... for two men it's $218 per hour... two and a half hour minimum... We're estimating... two and a half hours... $545 if it goes up to 3 hours it's $654. So it's a range from $545 to 650.' Personalized to customer's specific box count and item list (mattresses, TVs, floating shelves, minimal furniture).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Fee transparency: 'all inclusive rates... no other fees outside of the hourly rate... two men and the truck, all the reps to protect your furniture items... If you need help with this assembly reassembly taxes, insurance, credit card fees, fuel transportation fees, everything is already in the price.' Commitment framing: '2.5 hour minimum... we only charge in fifteen minute intervals.' Both present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After providing the estimate range ($545–$654), rep does not ask 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent, nor hold silence for customer reflection.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'on time guarantee if we run late on the time we schedule, we provide discounts by the end of the day.' Discount terms (starts discounting immediately if late) clearly stated.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: 'no worries damage coverage. It would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any repair, replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages... we already incorporate this, with your move.' $2,000 coverage and built-into-rate framing present; no deductible/fine-print language not explicitly stated but structure is clear.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent, and does not close out the Two Promises section with a confirmation question before moving to final concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Full genuine version: 'do you have any other questions?' — This is asked, but it is the 'any questions?' throwaway form, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' variant. Score as 'full' because the question was asked, but it is the weaker form.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No recognizable version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' — rep moves to closing without this safety check.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep does not ask 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Instead, rep says 'Definitely I'll go ahead and send everything to you in the email. If you're ready to go ahead with the booking just respond to the email give us a call whichever works for you.' This is a soft conditional (if/when ready), not an explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No statement that the quote holds or locks in at the stated rate.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: email address (TMJ.M.68@gmail.com), phone number (630-994-6273), move date (October 9, 2026), pickup address (4220 Tributary Way, Frisco TX 75034), delivery address (7257 Confetti Lane, Frisco TX 75033). Missing: arrival window (no specific time window given), crew size (no crew size discussed or confirmed), notes for crew about customer concerns (not captured or confirmed). 3 of 6 items confirmed.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, bedrooms, square footage, floor level, walking distance, room distribution, item specifics) with clear follow-up on the customer's exact inventory, enabling a precise estimate grounded in the customer's actual move profile.
coaching_note: Never asked 'Their Agenda' (Section 2's highest-value question), and failed to ask for an explicit commitment to book ('Would you like our help?') — these two omissions cost significant rapport and close likelihood; add both to your standard call flow before probing and before the final close.
booking_note: Customer said 'I'm gonna make a decision hopefully in the next hour' and wanted to compare quotes with competitors before committing. No date/time was locked in; only an estimate was provided pending the customer's decision.
